§6Nuclear Thermal Rocket Engine§f uses a nuclear reactor core to superheat hydrogen propellant, producing 2-3x the thrust of chemical rockets. It is the engine of choice for interplanetary missions beyond Earth orbit.

The motor requires a Nuclear Fission Core to operate and liquid hydrogen as propellant. Pipe hydrogen in from a Chemical Reactor feeding on Electrolyser output. Its thrust multiplier is the highest in AR and it is the only motor capable of escaping gas giant gravity wells.

§cWARNING:§f The nuclear engine's high-Isp exhaust requires a Structure Block frame around the engine to prevent terrain damage at ignition.

§ePS:§f Pair with Bipropellant Fuel Tanks of at least 50,000 mB capacity for a single interplanetary transfer.
